The reference subject is a person with short dark hair, shaved sides, and a small tied knot at the back, wearing a black high-collared tactical jacket, black trousers, and black combat boots.

The top panel shows the figure standing on a rain-slicked nighttime walkway with metal railings on both sides, rain streaks visible, reflective wet ground, a building facade behind, and warm amber lights in the distance.
The middle row contains three studio views of the same figure against a plain dark background: a frontal full-body view, a side-profile full-body view, and a rear full-body view.
The bottom row consists of close-up panels showing the face, jacket collar with strap and buckle details, two hands with visible veins, and black lace-up boots.
The face close-up shows a neutral expression and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
On-screen labels read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

The lighting is low-key and high-contrast, with cool blue-gray night tones and warm amber practical lights in the hero panel, while the studio panels use soft directional lighting against a near-black background.

description.text: The entire portrait-format character reference sheet fills the frame exactly as supplied at the opening instant, uncropped and with its full three-row layout intact: the wide cinematic rainy-night hero panel across the top, the row of three full-body studio turnaround views beneath it, and the four close-up detail crops along the bottom. The HERO title and the labels FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS remain legible in their original positions, and no panel is isolated, removed, cropped or redrawn. In the top hero panel, the black-clad figure stands upright between metal railings that run along both sides of a rain-slicked nighttime walkway. A dark building facade rises behind, and warm amber practical lights glow at a distance across the wet ground. The wet pavement mirrors the amber lamps in long vertical smears, and the metal railings catch thin highlights along their upper edges. The figure has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small tied knot at the back, a scar through one eyebrow, and an all-black tactical outfit: a high-collared jacket with straps and epaulet-like details, a black undershirt, black cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots. Rain streaks slide slowly down the panel, droplets gather along the railings, faint ripples and reflections drift across the wet pavement, and the figure's shoulders and jacket collar shift with the gentlest breathing motion while the neutral expression and visible scar stay unchanged. Below, the three studio views against the near-black backdrop hold their frontal, side-profile and rear standing poses, the same figure seen at consistent full-body scale, with each turnaround separated by the original panel spacing and only a soft directional light playing across the dark fabric, pale skin and boot leather. The bottom detail crops stay steady: the face with its neutral expression and scarred eyebrow, the jacket collar with strap and buckle details, the two hands with visible veins and relaxed fingers, and the black lace-up boots with taut laces. Cool blue-gray night tones and warm amber practical lights dominate the hero panel, while the studio panels keep low-key high-contrast lighting and soft directional highlights against near-black surroundings. The whole sheet remains the complete image throughout, with panel borders, lettering and figure appearance preserved as gentle rain, reflection and breathing motion bring the still reference sheet to life.
A soft, steady rain ambience with a faint wet-ground hush accompanies the animated sheet, underlining the falling droplets and reflective pavement.
